Priority stays with squat and One-Arm Pull-up. Monday is the main neural day, Tuesday keeps the assisted unilateral work clean but cheaper, Friday stays deliberately low-cost around the hard MMA day, Sunday gives you direct strict pressing plus an easy second squat touch, and the single run is placed away from the next primary squat day.

The long run is held at the tolerated dose.

Pain/subs: if elbows or the biceps tendon get cranky, keep Monday One-Arm Pull-up as all singles and use a little more help on Tuesday. If Push Press irritates the shoulder, use Overhead Press at the same RPE. If squat or run pain changes your mechanics, repeat the last clean load or trim the long run by 2-4 km instead of forcing progression.

START_WEEK1_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Mon	[WARMUP] Deep Squat Hold	Bodyweight	2	30 sec	30 sec	N/A	Then 3-4 short ramp sets for One-Arm Pull-up and squat; move on once hips and ankles feel open.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Ramp Back Squat: 70 kg x 5, 102.5 kg x 3, 135 kg x 1-2 before 172.5 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Mon	One-Arm Pull-up	Bodyweight	3	1 each side	2-3 min	7.5-8	Lead with the weaker arm. Set 1 is the priority set; take a 2nd rep on a side only if rep 1 is crisp and another strict rep is clearly in reserve. Week 1 standard: establish the benchmark - every single starts from a dead hang, no kip or swing, and you finish each side with at least one clean rep still in reserve. Record how each side felt; this is the standard Weeks 2-3 have to beat.	
Mon	Back Squat	172.5 kg	1	3	4 min	8	Heavy top set. If rep speed is clearly off or RPE overshoots, hold at 170-172.5 and do not chase load.	
Mon	Back Squat	165 kg	2	3	3-4 min	7.5	Back-off ceiling only; stop after 1 set if the top set already reached the effort ceiling or depth and brace soften.	
Mon	Push Press	RPE-selected load	3	3	2-3 min	7	Overload vertical press without grinding; crisp dip and fast lockout only.	
Mon	Cable Row	RPE-selected load	2	8	90 sec	6.5-7	Foundational pulling after One-Arm Pull-up; smooth scapular motion, no heaving.	
Tue	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Light band	2	15	30 sec	N/A	Then 2-3 easy ramp sets for assisted One-Arm Pull-up and bench.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Tue	Assisted One-Arm Pull-up	Minimum assistance	2	1 per arm	2-3 min	6-6.5	Minimum help for clean symmetrical reps; easier than Monday because it sits next to the strict day. Recovery-first pulling microdose: technical adjacent-day exposure only, keep it at RPE 6-6.5 or easier and stop well before local fatigue.	
Tue	Dumbbell Bench Press	RPE-selected load	2	8	90-120 sec	7	Horizontal press for muscle retention; stop 2-3 reps before failure.	
Tue	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	2	8	90 sec	7	Foundational row to support One-Arm Pull-up without adding more heavy vertical pulling.	
Tue	Barbell Hip Thrust	RPE-selected load	3	6	2 min	7	Hip-dominant support with low back cost; hard lockout, no sloppy reps.	
Tue	Calf Raise	RPE-selected load	2	12	60 sec	7	Running tissue capacity; full stretch and controlled top pause.	
Thu	Run	Easy conversational pace	1	18 km	N/A	5	Long run for the marathon pathway. Keep full-sentence pace and separate it from MMA by several hours if possible.	
Fri	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Light band	2	15	30 sec	N/A	Low-cost support day; keep everything smooth if sparring fatigue is high.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Fri	Back Squat	145 kg	2	4	3 min	6.5	Lower-cost specificity day; crisp depth and bar speed only because this sits before the heavy squat day.	
Fri	Chin-up	RPE-selected load	2	4	2-3 min	7.5	Bilateral strength reserve for One-Arm Pull-up. Stop after 1 set if elbows or grip feel dull from MMA.	
Fri	Dumbbell Bench Press	RPE-selected load	2	8	90 sec	6.5	Low-cost horizontal press; leave about 3 reps in reserve.	
Fri	Reverse Lunge	RPE-selected load	2	6 each leg	90 sec	6.5	Easy knee-dominant support; smooth reps only, no grinding.	
Fri	Neck Isometric	Bodyweight/manual resistance	2	20 sec each direction	30-45 sec	6	Neck robustness. First item to remove if session length or sport fatigue runs high.	
Sun	[WARMUP] Deep Squat Hold	Bodyweight	2	30 sec	30 sec	N/A	Then 2-4 short ramp sets for press and squat.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Ramp Overhead Press: 30 kg x 5, 42.5 kg x 3, 57.5 kg x 1-2 before 72.5 kg work sets.; Ramp Back Squat: 57.5 kg x 5, 87.5 kg x 3, 112.5 kg x 1-2 before 145 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Sun	Overhead Press	72.5 kg	4	4	2-3 min	7	Direct strict press. If set 3 already exceeds the ceiling or bar path deteriorates, hold the load and skip set 4. Held at RPE 7: this sits the day before the mon primary session, so it is a quality exposure and not a session to chase.	
Sun	Cable Row	RPE-selected load	2	8	90 sec	7	Horizontal pull balance; pause at the torso.	
Sun	Machine Hamstring Curl	RPE-selected load	2	10	60-90 sec	7	Posterior-chain support with low spinal cost.	
Sun	Plank	Bodyweight	2	45 sec	45 sec	6	Bracing without adding much fatigue.	
END_WEEK1_TSV
